title: Make the First One Square
tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

faults.what: The image has detailed, realistically shaded fur and a stark black background rather than the requested soft watercolour appearance.

judge.summary: The square image comfortably frames the sleeping fox and crescent moon, but its realistic rendering does not deliver the requested soft watercolour style.

must_haves.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
must_haves.why: The sleeping fox and crescent moon are both contained within the frame, with only natural overlap between them, but the original illustration is not supplied to verify their identity.

must_haves.item: The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
must_haves.why: No original image is available for comparison of character details and colours; the visible output also does not clearly read as soft watercolour.

must_haves.item: It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.
must_haves.why: Only the fox-and-moon scene is visible, with no lighthouse or storm scene.
